lead: A case cannot index into an `array<mixed>`'s elements, and `Core\Json::encode` is the way round it.
body: `$q["b"] as array<string>` panics `nvs-ir` outright (*"got `Tagged as Array`"*) — `rule:types/conversion`'s `array<T> as array<U>` row is the one still missing — so a member answering a nested shape has no spelling that reaches past the first level. `Core\Json::encode($q)` renders the whole structure in one line, byte-identical to PHP's `json_encode`; `$q["a"] as string` on a top-level scalar does lower.
